description: Base server URL for the authenticated Devin MCP server. Streamable HTTP endpoint at /mcp; legacy SSE /sse deprecated.
Recommended Streamable HTTP endpoint for Devin MCP server. Full URL: https://mcp.devin.ai/mcp.
Legacy SSE endpoint — DEPRECATED. Migrate clients to /mcp.
Base server URL for the free no-auth DeepWiki MCP server. Public repos only.
Recommended Streamable HTTP endpoint for DeepWiki MCP server.

Prefix Devin MCP auth tokens use. Three flavors share this prefix: org-scoped service-user keys (auto-resolves org), enterprise service-user keys (need X-Org-Id), personal access tokens (need X-Org-Id).
Legacy API key prefixes that are NOT accepted by Devin MCP server. Customers using these must rotate to a `cog_`-prefixed service-user key first.
Required header for enterprise service-user keys + PATs. Specifies which Devin organization to target. Org-scoped service-user keys auto-resolve the org and don't need this header.
Universal Database Toolbox Docker image. One image for all 22+ database integrations.

Database Toolbox CLI flag selecting a built-in DB configuration. Valid values: alloydb-postgres, bigquery, cloud-sql-mysql, cloud-sql-postgres, cloud-sql-mssql, dataplex, firestore, looker, mysql, postgres, spanner, mssql.
Database Toolbox CLI flag pointing to a custom tools-config YAML. Used by Bigtable, Couchbase, Dgraph, MongoDB, Neo4j, Redis, Redshift, Snowflake, SQLite, TiDB, Valkey.
Required Database Toolbox CLI flag for MCP STDIO transport.
AlloyDB env-var family: ALLOYDB_POSTGRES_PROJECT, _REGION, _CLUSTER, _INSTANCE, _DATABASE, _USER, _PASSWORD. Plus GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS pointing at a service-account JSON.
BigQuery env-var family: BIGQUERY_PROJECT (required), BIGQUERY_DATASET (required), BIGQUERY_LOCATION (optional, default 'US'), GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS_PATH.
Bigtable env-var family (custom YAML mode): BIGTABLE_PROJECT, _INSTANCE, _TABLE, BIGTABLE_TOOLS_FILE, GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS_PATH.
Cloud SQL for MySQL env-var family: CLOUD_SQL_MYSQL_PROJECT, _REGION, _INSTANCE, _DATABASE, _USER, _IP_ADDRESS, _PASSWORD; GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS.
Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL env-var family: CLOUD_SQL_POSTGRES_PROJECT, _REGION, _INSTANCE, _DATABASE, _USER, _IP_ADDRESS, _PASSWORD; GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS.
Cloud SQL for SQL Server env-var family: CLOUD_SQL_MSSQL_PROJECT, _REGION, _INSTANCE, _DATABASE, _USER, _IP_ADDRESS, _PASSWORD; GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS.
Couchbase env-var family (custom YAML mode): COUCHBASE_HOST, _PORT (default 8091), _BUCKET, _USERNAME, _PASSWORD, COUCHBASE_TOOLS_FILE.

Dataplex env-var family: DATAPLEX_PROJECT, DATAPLEX_LOCATION, GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS pointing at service-account JSON. Special: supports inline DATAPLEX_CREDENTIALS_JSON via mktemp + bind-mount pattern.
PostgreSQL host. Required for prebuilt postgres mode.
PostgreSQL database name. Required.
PostgreSQL username. Required.
PostgreSQL password. Required. Pass via Devin Secrets, not hardcoded in args.
Spanner env-var family: SPANNER_PROJECT, SPANNER_INSTANCE, SPANNER_DATABASE; GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS.
Firestore env-var family: FIRESTORE_PROJECT (required), FIRESTORE_DATABASE (optional, default '(default)'), GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS.
Looker env-var family: LOOKER_BASE_URL, LOOKER_CLIENT_ID, LOOKER_CLIENT_SECRET.
Required. URL to the Metabase instance, e.g., https://metabase.acme.com.
Preferred Metabase auth. API key. When set, the server logs 'Using Metabase API Key'.
Fallback Metabase auth (with METABASE_PASSWORD). Used when METABASE_API_KEY is not set.
Fallback Metabase auth (with METABASE_USERNAME).
Default Metabase MCP tool-loading mode. Loads only essential tools (smaller curated set).
Metabase MCP tool-loading flag. Load all 80+ available tools.
Metabase MCP tool-loading flag. Load only read-only tools. Recommended for production-data scenarios.
Metabase MCP tool-loading flag. Load only write/modification tools.
Recommended Node.js version for Metabase MCP server. npm >= 8.0.0 also recommended.
Datadog MCP server requires two HTTP headers: DD-API-KEY (Organization Settings > API Keys) and DD-APPLICATION-KEY (Organization Settings > Application Keys).
Slack MCP requires a Bot User OAuth Token (starts 'xoxb-'). Found at api.slack.com/apps > <your app> > OAuth & Permissions. Requires app-level tokens + at least 1 scope + workspace install.
Slack workspace team ID. Retrieve via `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer xoxb-..." https://slack.com/api/auth.test`.
Slack channel IDs. Retrieve via conversations.list. Requires bot scopes channels:read, groups:read, mpim:read, im:read.
Supabase MCP requires a personal access token from supabase.com/dashboard/account/tokens.
Figma MCP requires an API key from Profile > Settings > Security > Personal access tokens. Recommended scopes: read on File content + Dev resources.
Stripe MCP requires Authorization header in the format `Bearer <STRIPE_API_KEY>`.
Zapier MCP requires Authorization Bearer token. Extract from the server URL at https://mcp.zapier.com/mcp/servers > Connect (the **** segment of the server URL).
Airtable MCP requires an API key from airtable.com/create/tokens.
Docker Hub MCP requires a username (My Hub) and Personal Access Token (Account settings > Personal access tokens).
SonarQube MCP requires three: API token (My Account > Security), org name (your username), URL (self-hosted: http://localhost:9000 or https://sonarqube.<co>; SonarCloud: https://sonarcloud.io).
Netlify MCP requires a Personal Access Token from app.netlify.com/user/applications#personal-access-tokens. Copy on creation — won't be shown again.
Pulumi MCP requires an access token from the Access tokens section in the Pulumi dashboard sidebar.
Heroku MCP requires an API key from https://dashboard.heroku.com/account.

CircleCI MCP requires CIRCLECI_TOKEN env var (created at app.circleci.com/settings/user/tokens; copy on creation, won't show again). Optional CIRCLECI_BASE_URL (default 'https://circleci.com'; on-prem customers must set).
Cortex MCP requires a personal access token from Settings > My access tokens. Default API URL: https://api.getcortexapp.com.
Square MCP requires an Authorization Bearer header with a Square access token.
HubSpot MCP requires an access token. Create a private app: Settings > Integrations > Private Apps > Create private app > set scopes > copy token from the Auth tab.
Redis MCP requires Redis host, port, username, password.

key: Google Maps: API key + per-API enables
description: Google Maps MCP requires an API key (console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials) AND each individual Google Maps API enabled in the project.
Firecrawl MCP requires API key from firecrawl.dev/app/api-keys.
Elasticsearch URL/endpoint, found on the /overview page in Elasticsearch.
Elasticsearch API key, created on the /indices/index_details/<name>/data page.
Elasticsearch optional flag. When `true`, skips SSL/TLS certificate verification when connecting.
Marketplace Postgres MCP requires only the Postgres connection string. Use a read-only connection or restricted-permission user for production data.
Grafana MCP requires Grafana URL and a service-account token. Create at Administration > Users and access > Service accounts > Add service account > Add service account token.
Pinecone MCP requires an API key. NOTE: only Pinecone indexes with INTEGRATED EMBEDDING are supported (as of 7/16/25). External-embedding indexes not yet supported.
Snyk MCP requires `unmanaged: true` flag for some frameworks (e.g., C++) to run scans correctly. Set in knowledge or during a session.
Replicate MCP requires an API token from replicate.com/account/api-tokens.
Parallel MCP requires an API key from platform.parallel.ai.
Plaid MCP requires an OAuth Bearer access token. Generate from dashboard.plaid.com/developers/keys.
Playwright MCP requires no environment variables. 1-click enable.

key: Linear: skip MCP if integration connected
description: If the Linear integration is connected, Linear MCP does NOT need to be configured separately. Devin already has native Linear tools using the integration's auth.
